title: Profitability Tuning — Disagreement Near-Miss Calibration, Confidence Penalty Verification, Per-Cycle Trade Frequency Telemetry, and Adaptive Floor Activation Audit
goal: Fix two under-calibrated analyzer thresholds (disagreement near-miss gap), verify confidence penalty ceiling is correctly scaled, add per-cycle trade frequency and gate-kill telemetry, and verify all three adaptive floors are activating correctly after the Phase 89 cold-start fix.
context: Phase 89 fixed the cold-start observe filter that blocked all trades when closed_trade_count==0. This session fixed sub_inference_gap_analyzer.py NEAR_MISS_GAP (0.10→0.35) and MODERATE_GAP (0.25→0.50), and disabled TF Metal to prevent M1 kernel panics. The disagreement_gap_analyzer.py still carries NEAR_MISS_GAP=0.10: the docstring was written at floor=0.30 where 2/5 disagreement produces gap=0.10 exactly. At the current floor=0.50 (Phase 81), 3/5 disagreement produces gap=0.10 and 4/5=0.80 produces gap=0.30 — classified MODERATE instead of NEAR_THRESHOLD, so the adaptive mechanism under-responds. The confidence_penalty_ceiling.py had its constant fixed to 0.40 in Phase 79 but the module docstring still says '40.0 (on 0-100 scale)', creating maintenance confusion; tests should verify ceiling is actually clipping. Trade frequency telemetry is absent from _log_scan_cycle: it records tradeable_count but not trades_attempted vs executed vs the specific gates that killed each scan cycle. The three adaptive floors require trade history; cold-start may have prevented them from accumulating state — a post-Phase-89 activation audit is needed.

acceptanceCriteria: Create src/scanner/automation/learning_engine.py with LearningEngine class
LearningEngine.analyze_trade(trade_journal_entry: dict) examines a closed trade and returns list of LearningEntry(date, category, insight, action, source_trade_id)
Categories: 'sizing', 'entry_timing', 'sl_tp', 'agent_accuracy', 'regime', 'pair_behavior'

Analysis rules: (1) if SL hit and pnl_pips > 2x atr_pips → 'sl_too_tight for {pair}', (2) if TP hit in <15min → 'tp_could_be_wider for {pair}', (3) if trade lost and uncertainty_score > 0.45 → 'uncertainty_was_warning for {pair}', (4) if trade won and weighted_vote_score > 0.7 → 'high_consensus_works', (5) if model_disagreement > 0.3 and trade lost → 'disagreement_predicted_loss'
LearningEngine.append_to_learnings(entries: list[LearningEntry]) appends formatted entries to .claude/learnings.md with date prefix
Integrate into ExecutionManager.sync_closed_trades_rl(): after syncing each trade, call learning_engine.analyze_trade(entry) and append results
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: sync_closed_trades_rl() is at src/scanner/execution.py. Each journal entry has full context: gates, agents, regime, outcome.

userStories.title: Post-Phase-89 adaptive floor activation audit script
acceptanceCriteria: Create src/scanner/automation/config_tuner.py with ConfigTuner class
ConfigTuner.load_rules() parses .claude/rules/trading.md and extracts actionable rules

ConfigTuner.apply_to_config(scanner_config: ScannerConfig) reads rules and adjusts config fields: (1) 'sl_too_tight for {pair}' → increase atr_sl_multiplier by 0.1 for that pair, (2) 'tp_could_be_wider for {pair}' → increase atr_tp_multiplier by 0.1, (3) 'uncertainty_was_warning' → lower max_uncertainty_score by 0.02, (4) 'high_consensus_works' → lower weighted_vote_threshold by 0.01, (5) 'disagreement_predicted_loss' → lower max_model_disagreement by 0.02
ConfigTuner tracks adjustments in .claude/config_adjustments.json with timestamp and reason
Each adjustment is bounded: atr_sl_multiplier max 2.0, atr_tp_multiplier max 3.0, max_uncertainty_score min 0.30, weighted_vote_threshold min 0.45, max_model_disagreement min 0.20
Integrate into ContinuousScanner: before each scan, call config_tuner.apply_to_config(self.scanner.config)
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: This closes the loop: trade outcome → learning → rule → config change → better trades. Bounds prevent runaway tuning.

userStories.title: Add session improvement summary and metrics tracking

userStories.title: Create buddy_learn CLI command for manual learning triggers
userStories.description: As a developer, I want a CLI command to manually trigger learning analysis, view current learnings, and force rule promotion.
acceptanceCriteria: Add 'learn' subcommand to CLI that accepts: buddy_scanner.py learn [--analyze] [--promote] [--consolidate] [--report] [--status]
